title: Booking a workshop room
passage:
M1: We need a room for a drawing workshop. There will be twenty-four people, so we need tables. Theater seating will not work.
F1: Here are the room listings. The middle column shows how many people fit with tables.
M1: We can spend up to two hundred dollars. A larger room would cost too much.
F1: Then I recommend the room for thirty people. A projector comes with every room.
M1: Please book it for Monday. We need to get in half an hour early to set out drawing supplies.
F1: Of course. I'll put eight thirty as your arrival time on the confirmation.
passageZh:
M1：我們需要一間辦繪圖工作坊的教室。會有二十四人，所以需要桌子。劇院式座位不適合。
F1：這是各間教室的出租資訊。中間欄顯示擺放桌子時可容納的人數。
M1：我們最多可以花兩百美元。更大的教室會太貴。
F1：那我推薦可容納三十人的那間教室。每間都附投影機。
M1：請預訂星期一。我們需要提早半小時入場，擺放繪圖用品。
F1：沒問題，我會在確認函上註明你們八點半抵達。

We need a room for a drawing workshop. There will be twenty-four people, so we need tables. Theater seating will not work.
Here are the room listings. The middle column shows how many people fit with tables.
We can spend up to two hundred dollars. A larger room would cost too much.
Then I recommend the room for thirty people. A projector comes with every room.
Please book it for Monday. We need to get in half an hour early to set out drawing supplies.
Of course. I'll put eight thirty as your arrival time on the confirmation.
